Helpers to load test accounts and restore feature flags for runtime fuzz tests.

# Purpose
This C file provides helper functions for runtime fuzz testing. The [`fd_runtime_fuzz_load_account`](<#fd_runtime_fuzz_load_account>) function creates or loads an account into the transaction account state from a test account description. It checks optional zero-lamport rejection, verifies that the account does not already exist in the account database, initializes the account from `fd_funk`, copies account data when present, and sets the account fields for lamports, executable state, owner, and read-only status. It then finalizes the mutable account update. The function returns `1` on success and `0` when the account cannot be loaded.

The [`fd_runtime_fuzz_restore_features`](<#fd_runtime_fuzz_restore_features>) function restores a feature set for test execution. It first disables all features, then iterates through the feature IDs in the test feature set, resolves each feature prefix to a feature ID, and enables each supported feature from genesis. If a feature prefix does not map to a known feature ID, it logs a warning and returns `0`. This file depends on generated context types, account database helpers, and feature management APIs, and it exposes utility logic used by fuzz test code rather than a public application interface.
